document.title: Build a waitlist for your next launch

use_when: Join a waitlist first, then optionally ask for email; absence of email must not undo membership.
avoid_when: Do not choose for registration that legally or operationally requires an email.
Do not silently drop an essential unsupported gate.
required_facts: Launch identity, waitlist membership definition and optional email purpose.
Confirm account scope, messaging permission and the real outcome measurement.
